form.label: O365 cloud account abuse
form.description: Frothly Office 365 management-activity review: anonymous file sharing, external retrievals of the shared file, and Set-Mailbox runs by regular mailbox users.

search.query: index=* sourcetype=ms:o365:management Operation=AnonymousLinkUsed UserId=anonymous | stats dc(ClientIP)
index=* sourcetype=ms:o365:management Operation=Set-Mailbox UserId="*@froth.ly" | stats count

panel.title: Anonymous links created (who, from where, which file)

search.query: index=* sourcetype=ms:o365:management Operation=AnonymousLinkCreated | stats count by UserId, ClientIP, SourceFileName | sort -count

panel.title: External IPs that retrieved the shared file

search.query: index=* sourcetype=ms:o365:management Operation=AnonymousLinkUsed UserId=anonymous | stats count by ClientIP, SourceFileName | sort -count

panel.title: Set-Mailbox runs by employee accounts (target mailboxes)

search.query: index=* sourcetype=ms:o365:management Operation=Set-Mailbox UserId="*@froth.ly" | stats count by UserId, ObjectId | sort -count
